newsitem.title: USA: Lodging Trust requests to withdraw IPO.
newsitem.headline: Lodging Trust requests to withdraw IPO.

text.p: Lodging Trust USA has requested to withdraw its registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering, its adviser RFS Hotel Investors Inc said.
Lodging Trust was formed recently to develop and own mid-priced, extended-stay hotels.

"We recommended that the proposed offering be withdrawn as a result of our concerns about recent changes in the market for IPOs in general, and for small, early-stage companies in particular," RFS President Minor Perkins said in a statement.
